BiblicalUsage: Jiphtach-el is a place in Palestine, a valley on the border of Zebulun and Asher. In Joshua 19:14, the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthah-el. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: The valley marks the border of Zebulun and Asher, and I hold that Jiphtach-el shows God drawing the lines between His tribes.
